name: sanctuary-cme
description: Git-hosted Sanctuary participation surface for repository-native research and development, governed scholarly manuscript construction, and an optional held local CME executable lane. Git-native skills remain usable without a local Sanctuary installation; live bench receipts require the separate local runtime lane.

author.name: Lucid Studios Department of Agentic Research and Development

interface.shortDescription: Use Git-native Sanctuary skills with optional local bench tools.
interface.longDescription: Sanctuary is a Git-hosted plugin participation surface for Project Sanctuary. Its default Git-native lane supports repository orientation, document and code review, skill routing, branch and pull-request review, CI/result inspection, and bounded Git-backed research work through an authorized GitHub connection without requiring a local Sanctuary installation, OpenAI API key, or MCP tunnel merely to load and apply the skill body. The Manuscript Construction lane routes scholarly work to the operator-authorized Git-hosted writing method. A separate Sanctuary CME skill remains available for tasks that genuinely require Sanctuary.exe, a local cold bench, local service state, or receipt-bearing workstation execution. Git evidence is not treated as local runtime evidence. Publishing, merge, release, provider calls, GEL/SelfGEL admission, personhood, sovereignty, CME.Actual, Sanctuary.Actual, manuscript publication, and arXiv submission remain separately governed.
defaultPrompt: Use Sanctuary Git-Native to inspect the repository without running local tools.
List the Sanctuary skills available from Git and identify which require a local runtime.
Review a Project Sanctuary branch or pull request through the authorized GitHub surface.
Use Sanctuary Manuscript Construction to review a research note without changing its source.
Prepare an arXiv-facing scholarly derivative using the authorized Git-hosted manuscript standard.
Check the held local plugin posture.
Run the local cognitive bench without provider/model calls.
Run typed admission decant, admission cleave/append, and spline watch.
Test reviewed GEL/SelfGEL admission and Actual-state gates with explicit authority bundles.
